final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM major_counts) AS share FROM major_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_count) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_above_overall_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share
